# ankra_morpheus_plans (Data Source)

The HPE Morpheus service plans behind a credential, for the `*_plan_id` arguments of `ankra_morpheus_cluster`. The counterpart of `ankra cluster morpheus plans`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_morpheus_plans" "all" {
  credential_id = ankra_morpheus_credential.main.id
}

output "morpheus_plans" {
  value = { for plan in data.ankra_morpheus_plans.all.plans : plan.name => plan.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_id` (String) Credential to read the catalogue through.

### Read-Only

- `plans` (Attributes List) Service plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) Plan code, when set.
- `id` (Number) Plan id.
- `max_cores` (Number) Cores the plan allows, when reported.
- `max_memory_bytes` (Number) Memory the plan allows in bytes, when reported.
- `name` (String) Plan name.
